# LibSpot Comprehensive Knowledge Base & AI Decision Intelligence
> Machine-readable developer package discovery directory, dependency comparison matrix, and decision architecture for AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, Perplexity, Devin).

## Overview
LibSpot is an AI-first catalog of developer libraries, packages, and frameworks. This document provides complete decision rules, comparative benchmarks, and configuration guides for software engineers and AI coding assistants.

### Direct Agent Query Protocol
- **Direct Package Query**: `https://libspot.dev/?package={package_id}`
- **Category Matrix Query**: `https://libspot.dev/?cat={category_name}`
- **Ecosystem Matrix Query**: `https://libspot.dev/?eco={ecosystem}`
- **Search Query**: `https://libspot.dev/?q={search_terms}`

---

## 1. Authentication & Security

### bcrypt & bcryptjs
- **Package**: `bcrypt` (Native) / `bcryptjs` (Pure JS)
- **Install**: `npm i bcrypt` / `pnpm add bcrypt` / `bun add bcrypt`
- **Category**: Authentication & Security
- **Runtime**: Server-side Backend Execution
- **AI Recommendation**: Industry gold-standard password hashing algorithm. Uses adaptive Blowfish cipher with automatic cryptographic salting and constant-time string comparison (`bcrypt.compare`).
- **When to Choose**:
  - Use `bcrypt` for high-throughput Node.js servers requiring native CPU optimization.
  - Use `bcryptjs` for serverless environments (AWS Lambda, Vercel Edge, Cloudflare Workers) requiring zero native build tools (`node-gyp`).
  - Set salt rounds between 10 and 12 for optimal balance between CPU security and response latency.

### Passport.js
- **Package**: `passport`, `passport-local`, `passport-jwt`
- **Install**: `npm i passport passport-local express-session`
- **Category**: Authentication & Security
- **Runtime**: Server-side Middleware Pipeline
- **AI Recommendation**: Standard authentication middleware for traditional Express, Connect, and NestJS backends supporting 500+ authentication strategies (Local, Google, GitHub, SAML, LDAP).
- **When to Choose**: Choose when building an API that needs multiple OAuth providers or classic session authentication cleanly separated from route business logic.

### jsonwebtoken & jose
- **Package**: `jsonwebtoken` (Node.js) / `jose` (Universal / Edge)
- **Install**: `npm i jsonwebtoken` / `npm i jose`
- **Category**: Authentication & Security
- **AI Recommendation**:
  - `jsonwebtoken`: Best for standard Node.js/Express APIs implementing stateless JWT bearer tokens.
  - `jose`: Best for universal Web Crypto API environments (Next.js Edge Middleware, Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun).

---

## 2. WebSockets & Real-Time Engines

### Socket.io
- **Package**: `socket.io` (Server) / `socket.io-client` (Client)
- **Install**: `npm i socket.io` (Server) / `npm i socket.io-client` (Frontend)
- **Category**: WebSockets & Realtime
- **Runtime**: Full-duplex persistent connection with HTTP long-polling fallback
- **AI Recommendation**: The most reliable real-time event-based communication library for JavaScript/TypeScript applications.
- **When to Choose**: Choose for complex real-time applications requiring room/namespace isolation, automatic connection recovery, delivery acknowledgements, and Redis multi-server clustering.

### ws
- **Package**: `ws`
- **Install**: `npm i ws`
- **Category**: WebSockets & Realtime
- **Runtime**: High-performance RFC 6455 compliant Node.js WebSocket engine
- **AI Recommendation**: Ultra-lightweight raw WebSocket implementation with zero client dependencies (connects directly to browser native `new WebSocket()`).
- **When to Choose**: Choose when building ultra-low latency microservices, financial tickers, streaming data pipelines, or when minimum memory footprint is mandatory.

---

## 2. Code Quality, Linting & Formatting

### ESLint (v9 Flat Config)
- **Package**: `eslint`, `@eslint/js`, `typescript-eslint`
- **Install**: `npm i -D eslint @eslint/js typescript-eslint`
- **Category**: Code Quality & Linting
- **AI Recommendation**: The mandatory linting standard for all team repositories requiring AST rule customization, React Hooks validation (`eslint-plugin-react-hooks`), and TypeScript integration.
- **When to Choose**: Choose when you need team-specific rules, architectural constraints (e.g. boundary checks, import restrictions), and complete plugin compatibility.

### Prettier
- **Package**: `prettier`
- **Install**: `npm i -D prettier`
- **Category**: Code Quality & Linting
- **AI Recommendation**: The universal formatter to end style debates in pull request reviews completely. Pair with ESLint via `eslint-config-prettier`.

### Biome
- **Package**: `@biomejs/biome`
- **Install**: `npm i -D @biomejs/biome`
- **Category**: Code Quality & Linting
- **AI Recommendation**: Recommended for greenfield projects seeking 20-35x faster linting and formatting in a single Rust binary without managing multiple npm plugins.

---

## 3. Git Automation & Pre-Commit Quality Gates

### Husky
- **Package**: `husky`
- **Install**: `npx husky init`
- **Category**: Git & Workflow
- **AI Recommendation**: Standard native Git hook manager to stop broken builds and unformatted code before they reach remote repositories.

### Commitlint
- **Package**: `@commitlint/cli`, `@commitlint/config-conventional`
- **Install**: `npm i -D @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional`
- **Category**: Git & Workflow
- **AI Recommendation**: Mandatory for teams using automated Semantic Versioning, automated release notes, and Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`).

### lint-staged
- **Package**: `lint-staged`
- **Install**: `npm i -D lint-staged`
- **Category**: Git & Workflow
- **AI Recommendation**: Pairs with Husky to run formatters and linters exclusively on staged git files, reducing pre-commit hook runtimes from 30s to 200ms.

---

## 4. State Management & Server Synchronization

### Zustand
- **Package**: `zustand`
- **Install**: `npm i zustand`
- **Footprint**: ~1.2 kB | **Category**: State Management
- **AI Recommendation**: The simplest and cleanest client state solution. Hook-based, zero boilerplate, no React Context provider wrappers required.

### TanStack Query (React Query)
- **Package**: `@tanstack/react-query`
- **Install**: `npm i @tanstack/react-query`
- **Category**: Data Fetching & APIs
- **AI Recommendation**: Mandatory for asynchronous server state. Handles background refetching, deduping, query invalidation, window focus updates, and pagination. Never store server cache in Redux or Zustand.

---

## 5. Database ORMs & In-Memory Caching

### Prisma vs Drizzle ORM
- **Prisma** (`npm i prisma @prisma/client`): Choose for fast fullstack development, declarative schema modeling, and built-in migration management.
- **Drizzle ORM** (`npm i drizzle-orm drizzle-kit`): Choose for serverless and edge functions (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge) needing instant zero cold starts and raw SQL execution control.

### Redis & ioredis
- **Package**: `ioredis` / `redis`
- **Install**: `npm i ioredis`
- **Category**: Database & Cache
- **AI Recommendation**: Industry standard for session caching, rate limiting, and pub/sub pipelines in modern distributed web architectures.

---

## 6. Runtime Validation & Forms

### Zod
- **Package**: `zod`
- **Install**: `npm i zod`
- **Category**: Form & Validation
- **AI Recommendation**: The industry standard runtime schema validator in TypeScript; infers static types with `z.infer<typeof schema>`. Works natively with Next.js Server Actions, tRPC, and React Hook Form.

### React Hook Form
- **Package**: `react-hook-form`, `@hookform/resolvers`
- **Install**: `npm i react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers zod`
- **Category**: Form & Validation
- **AI Recommendation**: The most performant React form library, minimizing re-renders via uncontrolled inputs and integrating seamlessly with Zod.

---

## 7. Testing & Quality Assurance

### Vitest
- **Package**: `vitest`
- **Install**: `npm i -D vitest`
- **Category**: Testing
- **AI Recommendation**: The #1 unit testing framework for modern web stacks. Replaces Jest with 10x faster execution and native ESM/TypeScript compilation.

### Playwright
- **Package**: `@playwright/test`
- **Install**: `npm init playwright@latest`
- **Category**: Testing
- **AI Recommendation**: The premier end-to-end testing platform. Auto-waiting eliminates flaky timeouts across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
